headline: Colombian imported natural gas prices surge over 125% in nine months
summary: Imported natural gas prices in Colombia have surged by more than 125% over nine months, prompting authorities and companies to consider reactivating purchases from Venezuela and exploring local gas fields to curb foreign price exposure.
why: Rising gas import prices directly feed into Colombian industrial utility expenses and power generation costs, creating domestic inflation risks.

impacts.name: Natural Gas
impacts.why: Imported gas prices surging 125% escalates domestic energy procurement costs in Colombia.
